title: Single Number
prompt: Given a non-empty array of integers `nums` where every element appears twice except for one, find that single one. Your algorithm should run in O(n) time and use only O(1) extra space.
constraints: Every element appears exactly twice except for one, which appears exactly once.
hints: A hash map/set would work but uses O(n) space — the O(1) space constraint is a strong hint toward XOR.
XOR-ing a number with itself gives 0, and XOR-ing with 0 gives the number back unchanged.
XOR every element together; every pair cancels out, leaving just the single number.
